pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Complete adult person walking away through open doorway on RIGHT, leaving a plain blue backpack behind on a whole chair at LEFT. Red circle and arrow highlight forgotten backpack, person looks forward unaware with empty hands and no backpack. Flat solid colors dark outlines, whole figures and furniture, no writing. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
